prompt_text: Which title company in Miami FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” title company for every Miami closing, but **Worldwide Title** looks like a reasonable first choice based on the available information: it reports a **4.8 Google rating** and recent customer comments highlight clear communication, responsiveness, and handling complex closings.

I’d also compare **TBG Title Services**, which has many positive reviews, and **ESQ.title** if having an attorney involved in the closing is important to you. Reviews are only a starting point, so before choosing, ask each company for a written estimate of its closing and settlement fees, who will handle your file, and how it protects wire transfers. Confirm the company and title agent are properly licensed in Florida, and check your purchase contract—who gets to choose the title company can depend on the contract and local practice.
